quarterly_data.quarter: Simulations Plus press release: Simulations Plus Announces Funded Partnership with Global (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Simulations Plus announced a funded partnership with a global large pharmaceutical company (not named in the release) to apply Turin, its AI-enabled scientific engine for quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), within an active therapeutic development program. The pharmaceutical partner will use Turin within a hosted environment, supported by Simulations Plus scientists; the collaboration will evaluate how AI-enabled exploration of mechanistic model structures can substantially reduce the time required to build and evaluate QSP models, and the partnership is intended to rapidly expand into more therapeutic development programs. The release says Turin's capabilities are further enhanced by the technical collaboration with NVIDIA announced in May 2026. CEO Shawn O'Connor: 'Turin is designed to break down that barrier and make QSP practical for a broader range of development decisions.'
quarterly_data.counterparty: a global large pharmaceutical company (not named)
